scope: APPLICATION BEHAVIOUR ONLY — current operational scanning

architecture.decision: READ-TIME OPERATIONAL OVERLAY, not a DB repair
architecture.historical_universe: bars.universe — 618 tickers, legacy historical semantics, UNCHANGED
architecture.separation: separate code paths; neither silently substitutes for the other
architecture.deliberately_untouched: scanner.get_universe_tickers() — shared with signal_replay, pooled_stats, ultra_pump_research, bulk_export and the nightly writer; changing it would have moved far more than this operational scan

root_cause.layer_1: scanner.get_tickers() scrapes Wikipedia live then rewrites x.replace('.','-'), turning BRK.B into BRK-B
root_cause.layer_2: scanner._FALLBACK unions 671 hardcoded names, 132 of them not current
root_cause.layer_3: _is_valid_stock_ticker() rejects any dotted symbol as preferred, discarding BRK.B and BF.B
root_cause.result: 618 scanned instead of 503: ~25 delisted/renamed and ~92 live ex-constituents

C5.derived_from: frozen artifacts only — never bars.universe, never market data, never ticker availability

C6.note: the 117 non-current names remain in historical storage; they are excluded from the CURRENT operational scan, not deleted or relabelled

C7.note: these five are regression FIXTURES, not implementation logic — the fix is the frozen map, not a hand-typed rename dictionary

C8.exempted_in_turbo: frozen members bypass _is_valid_stock_ticker, which classifies any dotted symbol as preferred stock and would otherwise discard two ordinary index constituents

C1_C4.verification: CODE CONTRACT (static parse) PLUS a live browser cycle — see browser_verification below

browser_verification.method: in-app browser against http://127.0.0.1:8080 after a real backend restart and a full page reload
browser_verification.spinner_was_honest: while the spinner showed, two POST /api/studio/ultra-from-db requests were genuinely in flight; it cleared when they returned. This was checked rather than assumed — a persistent spinner is exactly the defect under repair, so it had to be distinguished from a real pending request.
browser_verification.defect_found_by_this_check: the first mount implementation collapsed running=false into NOT_RUN, which would have labelled a COMPLETED scan 'not run yet'. completed_at is what separates the two and is now used.
browser_verification.second_defect_found: fetchFromDB set `scanning` without setting scanState, so a DB-instant fetch rendered 'Scanning…' and 'not run yet' at the same time. Fixed.

overlay_query_cost.assessment: acceptable; the DB-instant latency is downstream enrichment, not membership selection

C10.auto_trigger: none — no scan starts on its own

coverage_semantics.note: BRK.B and BF.B have no local bar rows and are reported as CURRENT_MEMBER_LOCAL_HISTORY_MISSING — a coverage state, never a membership change and never a silent drop
